title: reference_verification weight misstated: it is 0.15 (reduced), not 0.20; the 0.15→0.20 raise and "most critical predictor" belong to rental_history
evidence:
Diff: "- `reference_verification` is a first-class scoring category; weight raised 0.15 → 0.20
  per `tenant_scorer/tools/scoring_tools.py` comment ("most critical predictor")." and "**`reference_validator_agent` and the `reference_verification` scoring category (weight
  0.20, "most critical predictor") already exist**". Actual RightTenantryAgents/tenant_scorer/tools/scoring_tools.py lines 10-17: "# affordability raised 0.20 -> 0.30 (industry 30-40% norm); rental_history
# raised 0.15 -> 0.20 ("most critical predictor"); reference_verification,
# red_flag_detection, application_completeness reduced.
WEIGHT_REFERENCE_VERIFICATION = 0.15  # Social proof of tenancy reliability
WEIGHT_RENTAL_HISTORY = 0.20  # Tenancy track record"
detail: The 0.15→0.20 raise and "most critical predictor" phrase describe rental_history; reference_verification was among the categories reduced in the 2026-05-04 rebalance and sits at 0.15. The claim is repeated three times across two of the new files.
recommended_fix: Correct all three occurrences: reference_verification weight is 0.15 (reduced in the 2026-05-04 rebalance); the 0.20 "most critical predictor" weight is rental_history.

title: Consent infra claims outdated: consent_record table was renamed to acknowledgement_record (column consent_type → record_type), and the rename explicitly repudiates treating these rows as consent
evidence:
Diff: "- Consent infra exists: `consent_type` enum (`data_processing`, `ai_analysis`,
  `data_sharing`) + `consent_record` table — a new `reference_calling` consent type for
  the *applicant* (attestation that referees expect contact) fits this pattern." Actual supabase/migrations/20260422000001_rename_consent_to_acknowledgement.sql: "-- Rename consent_record -> acknowledgement_record to reflect the lawful-basis
-- reality documented in the privacy policy: tenant-screening processing runs
-- under legitimate interest (DPC 2019 guidance), not Art. 6(1)(a) consent." and "    ALTER TABLE consent_record RENAME TO acknowledgement_record;" / "    ALTER TABLE acknowledgement_record RENAME COLUMN consent_type TO record_type;". Server code confirms: server/src/application/sql/create_acknowledgement_record.sql exists; remaining consent_record mentions in server/src are stale comments. Also 20260420000003: "ALTER TYPE consent_type ADD VALUE IF NOT EXISTS 'guarantor_attestation';"
detail: The consent_record table no longer exists (renamed to acknowledgement_record, column record_type); the enum list omits guarantor_attestation. Worse, the rename's stated rationale is that these rows are NOT consent — the doc's proposed reference_calling "consent type" repeats exactly the misreading the rename was designed to prevent.
recommended_fix: Update to: acknowledgement_record table with record_type column (enum consent_type incl. guarantor_attestation); frame the applicant attestation as an acknowledgement/attestation record, not consent, per the migration's lawful-basis rationale.

title: initial_schema.sql:75-77 citation covers only landlord_ref_*; employer_ref_* is at 78-80 and character_ref_* is not in the initial schema at all
evidence:
Diff: "- `application` table already stores reference trios: `landlord_ref_name/phone/email`,
  `character_ref_*`, `employer_ref_*` (supabase/migrations/00000000000001_initial_schema.sql:75-77;
  made mandatory in 20260420000001_mandatory_refs_and_per_adult_proof.sql)." Actual 00000000000001_initial_schema.sql lines 75-80: "  landlord_ref_name TEXT,
  landlord_ref_phone TEXT,
  landlord_ref_email TEXT,
  employer_ref_name TEXT,
  employer_ref_phone TEXT,
  employer_ref_email TEXT," — no character_ref columns anywhere in that file. Actual 20260420000001_mandatory_refs_and_per_adult_proof.sql lines 18-20: "  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS character_ref_name  text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS character_ref_phone text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS character_ref_email text;"
detail: The cited line range 75-77 covers only the landlord_ref trio; employer_ref_* sits at lines 78-80, and character_ref_* was added later by the very migration cited only for mandatoriness. Minor citation inaccuracy in an otherwise verified section.
recommended_fix: Cite initial_schema.sql:75-80 for the landlord/employer trios and attribute character_ref_* to 20260420000001_mandatory_refs_and_per_adult_proof.sql:18-20.
